programme.desc: With the working relationship between Batman and Robin on the rocks, the two struggle to put aside their differences to face off against Mr. Freeze and Poison Ivy, the latter of whom stokes the tension between the superhero duo.

programme.title: Mortal Kombat
programme.desc: When a young hero gets embroiled in a brutal, multi-dimensional battle, the experience gives him a new perspective on his limits and capabilities.

programme.title: Superman II
programme.desc: The legendary super hero makes a dangerous decision to give up his powers to be with his love, journalist Lois Lane. Meanwhile three notorious criminals from planet Krypton escape to seek revenge on Superman and to destroy planet Earth, with the help of Lex Luthor.

programme.title: Superman III
programme.desc: Ross Webster, a businessman, collaborates with a computer genius to carry out his evil plans, but when his plans are thwarted by Superman, he decides to use his weakness against him.

programme.title: Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice
programme.desc: After his battle in Metropolis, Bruce Wayne believes that Superman must be stopped, as the evil Lex Luthor manipulates Batman into defeating the Man of Steel.

programme.title: Superman
programme.desc: As his planet Krypton crumbles, the infant Kal-El survives by the machinations of his father and arrives on Earth to be raised by a kindly couple. As he grows up as Clark Kent, he utilizes his superpowers to defend the people of Earth against anyone who means them harm.

programme.title: Superman IV: The Quest for Peace
programme.desc: The Man of Steel faces a new threat as his arch nemesis Lex Luthor creates the radiation-charged Nuclear Man, and it's up to Superman to save the world from a nuclear war.

programme.title: Planet Terror
programme.desc: In Texas, a deadly battle rages inside an abandoned military base, causing the release of an experimental bio-nerve gas that turned people into flesh-eating, mutating zombies. A group of humans try to survive led by dancer Cherry, who uses an automatic rifle in place of her amputated leg.

programme.title: Knives Out
programme.desc: When the body of crime novelist Harlan Thrombey is found, Detective Benoit Blanc takes charge of the crime investigation and finds himself involved in numerous events in search of the truth.

programme.title: The Winning Season
programme.desc: Bill has once been a successful coach, but his alcohol problems cut his career short and ruined his future. When life is generous enough to give him a second chance at redemption by training a school girls' basketball team, will he get things right this time?

programme.title: The Witches
programme.desc: After a young orphan moves in with his grandmother, an encounter with a coven of witches turns his life upside down as the world's Grand High Witch prepares to implement her shady plans with the help of her fellow witches.

programme.title: Runaway Bride
programme.desc: Ike Graham is a journalist who usually writes his column attacking the opposite sex, in his last article he wrote about Maggie, famous in her hometown of getting engaged and running away each time at the altar. When Ike is fired for claims of inaccurate story, he decides to find out the truth himself.

programme.title: Words and Pictures
programme.desc: As they challenge each other on the way to falling in love, the rivalry between an art instructor and an English teacher comes to head when they decide to have their students decide which is more important: words or pictures.

programme.title: A Royal Night Out
programme.desc: In 1945, London receives V.E. Day with major celebrations as peace sweeps through Europe in the wake of the Nazi defeat. Joining the celebrations are Princesses Elizabeth and Margaret, who rebel against the route decided by their mother and escape their escorts for a wild adventure.

programme.title: Almost Christmas
programme.desc: In the aftermath of his wife's death, Walter Meyer invites his children and their families to his house for Christmas. But the dysfunctional siblings bring their drama and problems with them and bicker so much that Walter is unsure if they can withstand spending 5 days together.

programme.title: American Splendor
programme.desc: A comedy drama about the life of famous comic writer Harvey Pekar, as he merged reality with fiction, telling the story of his life and hardships until he achieved his dream.

programme.title: A Minecraft Movie
programme.desc: The evil Ender Dragon sets out to destroy everything, forcing a young girl and her team of adventurers to team up to save the Overworld from possible destruction.

programme.title: Sing
programme.desc: When his once-hustling theater falls on hard times, the impresario of the theater devises a plot to save his place by throwing a singing competition. However, the competition exceeds what he has anticipated, and he does his damndest to guarantee the success of the redeeming competition.

programme.title: Shark Tale
programme.desc: A mob boss shark's son is killed by a hunter, and another fish decides to take advantage of the situation and claim that he killed the shark. The fish is then chased by the sharks, but he is supported by other fish due to their hatred of sharks, which pushes them to go so far as to protect him from the sharks.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry
programme.desc: A look into the original meeting between the famous cartoon characters Tom and Jerry, and how they had to figure out a way to put aside their rivalry for the sake of the owners of the house they live in.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: Chipwrecked
programme.desc: When Chipmunks and Chipettes take a vacation on a cruise ship, things go out of control when they get stranded on a tropical island where they find out that they're not alone.

programme.title: Trolls
programme.desc: During a celebration, the Chef of the nefarious Bergens kidnaps a number of Trolls, all with the aim of serving them to the Troll-hungry Bergens. It's up to Princess Poppy and the grumpy Branch to find their friends before they become a meal for the Bergens.

programme.title: A Dog's Purpose
programme.desc: Getting repeatedly reincarnated, a dog comes to an understanding about what he is meant to do in the world as he interacts with various owners over multiple lifetimes.

programme.title: Antz
programme.desc: Z, an ant who feels insignificant in his totalitarian society, meets beautiful Princess Bala, and switches places with his soldier friend to impress her. They try to escape together, while an evil General is trying to tear their community apart.

programme.title: The Lorax
programme.desc: The 12-year-old Ted realizes the gloom of the natureless worlds he lives in and realizes that when love comes knocking, he cannot live in a world of dreams. As he tries to fulfill the wish of the girl he loves, he embarks on a journey to discover more about the charming creature, the Lorax.

programme.title: The Grinch
programme.desc: A grumpy Grinch leading a solitary life with his dog is annoyed when the neighboring city of Whoville decides to throw brighter, larger, and more cheerful celebrations. He hatches a scheme to ruin their festivities, but his nefarious plan collides with a cheerful plan of a cheerful young girl.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Road Chip
programme.desc: When a misunderstanding leads Alvin, Simon, and Theodore to believe that Dave is going to propose to his girlfriend, they are less than keen on the idea, both out of jealousy and protectiveness of their place in Dave's life, and out of a refusal to have the girlfriend's son in their lives.

programme.title: The Powerpuff Girls Movie
programme.desc: When an experiment accidentally creates three superpowered girls, they find themselves on the wrong side of the townspeople after a mishap. The girls soon find a way to get a second chance by fighting against a nefarious plot to take over the town as they come to learn of the extent of their powers.

programme.title: Barbie: Dreamtopia
programme.desc: On a journey full of magic and joy, Barbie, Chelsea, and their puppy Honey experience exciting adventures in a world of imagination, where they swim through rivers with pretty mermaids, and fly among clouds of cotton candy with fairies.

programme.title: Team Hot Wheels: The Origin of Awesome!
programme.desc: The boys Gage, Wyatt, Brandon and Rhett live in a very quiet town, but their lives change radically when they discover the world of speed and racing. They form Team Hot Wheels and embark on exciting races to save their town.

But Newt sees something other than danger and threat in those creatures.

programme.title: Happy Feet
programme.desc: According to the customs of Antarctic penguins, each penguin has to express his love to his mate by singing. But Mumble can't find his soul mate because he can't sing, despite having a great talent for tap dancing. Mumble tries to convince the elders to change their habits.

programme.title: Wa Baynaa Miead
programme.desc: The events revolve around two families; the family of Hassan, whose wife died and left him with four sons, and the family of Nadia, whose husband died and left behind four daughters. How will the two parties deal with the problems surrounding them, before and after their meeting?

programme.title: Al Board
programme.desc: In "The Board," everything is controlled by the strong, and the weak lack even self-control. Following her appointment as the company's CEO as a replacement for harasser Zaki, Mai sets out to establish her worth, prohibiting anyone from entering her personal space, in opposition to Rabeh, her longtime rival.

programme.title: Al-Kabir Awy 7
programme.desc: In the seventh season, a year after Al-Kabir married Marbouha, many disputes occur between them, urging them to go to a psychologist. On the other hand, Johnny is trying to do a new project in Al Mazarita.

programme.desc: The series tackles the Kuwaiti woman's struggle over decades, from the 60s till the present time, through a number of events, mainly the story of the open-minded Rashid who marries Sheikha, who was brought up in a conservative environment, as she begins to go through many transformations in her life.

programme.title: Grandpa, the Troublemaker

programme.title: El Batta El Safra
programme.desc: The story follows a withdrawn university professor, who gets involved in a robbery and cooperates with a gang called The Yellow Duck, which makes him fall into many adventures and mishaps.

programme.title: Al Matarid

programme.title: اثر - الحلقة 1
programme.desc: «أثر» برنامج وثائقي يُعرض على قناة سما دبي، يسلّط الضوء على شخصيات تركت بصمة مميزة في مجالات ثقافية وتراثية وإبداعية ورياضية وإنسانية. تُبنى كل حلقة حول رحلة الضيف منذ بداياته، مرورًا بالمحطات التي شكّلت تجربته، وصولًا إلى إنجازاته والأثر الذي تركه في مجتمعه. يعتمد البرنامج أسلوبًا بصريًا سينمائيًا يمزج بين المقابلة، والتصوير في المواقع المرتبطة بالقصة، والمواد الأرشيفية والمقتنيات والتجارب العملية، بعيدًا عن قالب الحوار التلفزيوني التقليدي. عملت في البرنامج بصفتي منتجًا، وأسهمت في البحث والتحضير، وبناء محاور الحلقات، وتحديد المواقع والمواد البصرية، والتنسيق الميداني، ومتابعة التصوير والمونتاج لضمان تقديم كل قصة بصورة إنسانية ومؤثرة.

programme.title: اثر - الحلقة 1
programme.desc: «أثر» برنامج وثائقي يُعرض على قناة سما دبي، يسلّط الضوء على شخصيات تركت بصمة مميزة في مجالات ثقافية وتراثية وإبداعية ورياضية وإنسانية. تُبنى كل حلقة حول رحلة الضيف منذ بداياته، مرورًا بالمحطات التي شكّلت تجربته، وصولًا إلى إنجازاته والأثر الذي تركه في مجتمعه. يعتمد البرنامج أسلوبًا بصريًا سينمائيًا يمزج بين المقابلة، والتصوير في المواقع المرتبطة بالقصة، والمواد الأرشيفية والمقتنيات والتجارب العملية، بعيدًا عن قالب الحوار التلفزيوني التقليدي. عملت في البرنامج بصفتي منتجًا، وأسهمت في البحث والتحضير، وبناء محاور الحلقات، وتحديد المواقع والمواد البصرية، والتنسيق الميداني، ومتابعة التصوير والمونتاج لضمان تقديم كل قصة بصورة إنسانية ومؤثرة.

programme.desc: ويتفرد برنامج "أحلام سعيدة" بما يُقدمه من معارفَ واسعةٍ تتعلق بأصول علم تفسير الأحلام وقواعده، وأحوال المفسر والشروط التي يجب أن تتوفر لديه ليتمكن من ممارسة هذا العلم الذي يمتاز بتعقيداته وتفاصيله العميقة، حيث يحرص مقدمه في أولى فقرات البرنامج على شرح معاني الرؤى الصادقة وعلاماتها، وكيفية التفريق بينها وبين أضغاث الأحلام، وإبراز أهمية العلوم المرتبطة بذلك، بما يُسهم في رفع مستوى الوعي لدى الجمهور حول هذا العلم وأهميته وكيفية تحليل رموزه المختلفة، وفق قواعدَ وأسسٍ علميةٍ واضحةٍ.

programme.title: موروثنا - الحلقة 5
programme.desc: الضيوف: ● د. ميثاء سيف الهاملي- شاعرة وكاتبة ومستشار ثقافي ● خلف الكعبي- خبير تراث ● علي خميس الرشيدي- خبير تراثي من البدو ● محمد سعيد الهيلي- خبير تراثي ملخص الحلقة في ضيافة الخيمة، تصحبنا عدسات موروثنا لنحلق عاليًا مع إحدى ركائز حياة الأوّلين (الخيمة) بأنواعها المتعددة من بيت الشعر إلى العريش والخيمة الحجرية، تسلّط الحلقة الضوء على مفهوم الخيمة لدى الأجداد والأحفاد، وكيف كانت مأوى للبدو الرحّل أو مستقَرًّا لأهل الحضر والمدن نكتشف كيف كانت تُصنع وتُبنى، ولماذا أصبحت رمزًا للدفء والجيرة الحسنة والتآخي فما أعظم استرجاع الماضي لاستخلاص المعاني، فموروثنا يسطر بحروف من نور كيف عانى الأجداد ليتميّز الأحفاد الخيمة ليست مجرد رمز، إنها حاوية الحياة ومهد الأحلام فمن خيمة الجد وُلد المجد

programme.title: دروب - الحلقة 12

programme.title: استشاري الشارقة

programme.title: سينما ٧
Cinema 7

programme.title: القافر
Al Qafer
programme.desc: ‫يمتلك رجل قدرة فريدة على سماع صوت المياه الجوفية. في خضم الجفاف والمشقة، يصبح موردا حيويا للمجتمع، ممزوجا مهارته النادرة بأسرار وصراعات محلية.‬

programme.title: نصيحة طبيب

programme.title: عباد الرحمن

programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح16 : ‫يعاني رئيس الحي وزوجته من مشاكل في زواجهما لعدم اتفاقهما على تبني طفل، إلى أن تصل عائلة إلى المدينة ومعها طفل غامض وأسرار عميقة.‬‬

programme.title: كونسرت
Concert
programme.desc: ‫‫يعتلي العديد من المغنين البارزين المسرح لأداء أكثر أغانيهم شعبية بهدف الترفيه عن الجمهور في مختلف أنحاء العالم.‬‬

programme.title: النويلاتي
Al Nweelati
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح9 : ‫بعد خروجه من السجن، يعود غواص للبحث عن الكنز المفقود والانتقام من الاشخاص الذين دمروا حياته وخانوه، مما يقلب الأمور رأسا على عقب ويقود للعديد من المواقف غير المتوقعة.‬‬

programme.title: على قد الحب

programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح14 : ‫تجد سيدة أعمال ناجحة نفسها مطاردة من قبل ماضيها، إذ تبدأ الأسرار والأحداث القديمة بالظهور من جديد، مما يزعزع راحة بالها ويهدد مستقبلها.‬‬

programme.title: نقطة انتهى

programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح14 : ‫يشعر فارس، وهو صيدلاني يعاني من مرض باركنسون، بالذنب بسبب قتله بالخطأ لشقيق زوجته المراهق بينما تحقق زوجته في مقتل شقيقها.‬‬

programme.desc: ‫‫يعرض المضيف تفاصيل النشرة الجوية ومعدل درجات الحرارة المتوقعة للأسبوع المقبل لمناطق مختلفة من حول الدولة.‬‬

programme.title: بحر الظلام

programme.desc: ‫‫الرحلة المروعة والمليئة بالصمود لنفس، وهي شابة تم بيعها لتزويجها في سن السادسة عشرة لرجل أعمال ثري ومضطرب نفسيا على مدار ثماني سنوات، تعيش نفس كابوسا من العنف المنزلي والأسر.‬‬
